ledger.title: Ledger
ledger.head: Head hash
ledger.intact: Chain intact — {count} entries re-derived from their canonical form.
ledger.explain: Verification recomputes every entry hash from the recorded metadata and checks that each entry links to its predecessor. It reads the whole chain rather than a sample.

storage.label: Storage immutability
storage.Enforced: Enforced — a deletion under retention was refused
storage.note: Proof rests on the hash chain and the external timestamp, both of which survive the storage being wiped. Object Lock is defence in depth.

timestamp.unqualifiedWarning: Timestamps are coming from a demonstration service. They are technically valid and verifiable, but will not carry a legal dispute. Configure a qualified provider before capturing anything you may need to rely on.

snapshot.title: Snapshot
snapshot.evidenceHint: A ZIP containing the archive, the protocol, the timestamp token and a verification script the other side can run themselves.
snapshot.notTimestamped: This snapshot has not been anchored yet. Anchoring runs once a day; an evidence package exported before then could not be verified independently.

audit.title: Audit log
audit.subject: Subject
audit.note: Reads are recorded here as well as writes. Entries cannot be edited or deleted.
